name: Wall Slide with Overhead Reach
steps: Stand with your back, head, and glutes resting flat against a smooth wall, with your feet placed about 6 inches forward.
Bring your arms up into a 'goalpost' position with your elbows and backs of your wrists touching the wall if possible.
Flatten your lower back gently toward the wall to prevent excessive arching.
Slowly slide your arms upward along the wall into an overhead reach, maintaining contact with your elbows and hands as much as comfortable.
Pause at the top of your comfortable range, then slowly slide your arms back down to the goalpost position.
coaching_cues: Do not force your wrists to touch the wall if it causes shoulder pain; stay within your pain-free zone.
Keep your ribs pulled down and avoid arching your lower back as your arms slide up.

sources.attribution: Cleveland Clinic Physical Therapy Mobility Guidelines
